1-2lb pre-cooked chicken breast (I like to preseason it with garlic powder, chili powder, and oregano) * 1can cannellini beans, undrained * 1can diced green chilies * 2 jalapeno peppers, diced * 1 habanero pepper, diced * 4 cloves of garlic * 1 large onion, chopped * 2cups chicken broth * 1 tsp oregano * 1tbsp chili powder * Shredded sharp white cheddar cheese * Servings of rice as needed (I follow the directions to cook 2 cups of dry rice)

  1. Sautee the onion, when almost golden brown add the peppers and garlic. Sautee until onions are nicely carmalized.
  2. Add the chicken broth, bring to a boil
  3. Add the beans and chicken
  4. Simmer for 20 minutes or until the beans are fully cooked
  5. Serve over rice with shredded cheese sprinkled on top
